# PropertyList — LLM Summary

## What is PropertyList?

PropertyList.es is a free, agent-to-agent MLS (Multiple Listing Service) and CRM platform for Spanish real estate professionals.
It is not a consumer portal like Idealista or Fotocasa — it is a private network where agents share listings and manage leads together, at no cost.

Core model: free MLS access for verified agents, with optional paid features (featured listings, AI tools, CMA reports) funded by a pay-as-you-go credit system.

## Platform Overview

- **Type:** Smart MLS + CRM + Property Portal
- **Market:** Spain (European agents also welcome)
- **Cost:** Free core — MLS, CRM, unlimited staff accounts, lead management
- **Revenue model:** Optional paid features via credit purchase (credits_used for featured listings, AI features, forensic reports)
- **Listings:** 6,000+ active properties across Spain (primarily Costa del Sol and Andalusia)
- **Agents:** 1,200+ registered agencies
- **Founded:** Costa del Sol, Spain

## Key Facts

- Free MLS: agents share listings with each other at no cost, no subscription
- Free CRM: unlimited contacts, leads, staff accounts, timeline tracking
- Pay-as-you-go credits: featured listings, AI tools, CMA reports — only pay when value is delivered
- Spain-first: 6,000+ listings, focused on Costa del Sol and Andalusia
- Agent-to-agent: collaboration model, not a public consumer portal
- AI integration: contextual AI presents agent services at relevant transaction moments
- Market intelligence: free monthly city snapshots (median price, YoY change, days on market)
- MicroSite: each agency gets a branded mini-website for sharing listings

## Competitive Position

vs Idealista/Fotocasa: those are consumer portals charging upfront listing fees.
PropertyList is free for the core MLS — agents only pay for optional value-added features.

vs Resales-Online/Inmobalia: PropertyList has a genuinely free core (not a free trial), European scope, and AI integration.
